status: Final source validated. Ticker performance remains unresolved; no universal speedup or presented-FPS claim.
provenance: Built from the working tree, including existing SVG changes outside this patch. Those changes are preserved and are not committed with this optimization.

method.comparison: Native and sandbox-backed WebKit with identical HTML and sandbox policy
method.order: Renderer order reversed on alternate rounds
method.host_fps: Requested sandbox callbacks per second; not presented frames
method.cpu: Percent of one core, host plus WebKit helpers, excluding WindowServer

native_ab_with_transport_recording.method: Three serial runs per variant; reverse variant order in round two. CPU is percent of one core, including WebKit helpers, excluding WindowServer. Host callbacks are not display FPS.
native_ab_with_transport_recording.scope: Historical native A/B before final backdrop and paint-order refinements. Native recording was equivalent in both binaries; do not use its WebKit records for current comparisons because the recording payloads differed.

gradient-probe.method: One serial run per variant; exploratory probe only. Same binary; before disables CSS gradient strips. Full transport recording is disabled for all variants. CPU is percent of one core, including WebKit helpers, excluding WindowServer. Host callbacks are not display FPS.

width-probe.method: One serial run per variant; exploratory probe only. Same binary; before disables sustained-width clip demotion. Full transport recording is disabled for all variants. CPU is percent of one core, including WebKit helpers, excluding WindowServer. Host callbacks are not display FPS.

frozen_method: Capture after one second of live updates, freeze deterministic state, render at 480 CSS px and 2x scale. Compare baseline to final native RGBA bytes. This is snapshot parity, not frame-presentation verification.

validation.review_regressions: Seven failed assertions reproduced paint-order and primed backdrop exclusion leaks before their fixes; all five scoped exclusion tests then passed.

manual_validation.app_build: No full Telegram build. Release TwidgetLab and renderer package tests only.

clipped-ticker: Pause changes to Resume and freezes motion
Lock width changes to Resize and expands the grid
Host scroll down two pages and back recovers all visible cards
order-book: Details opens a modal over live quotes
Close restores the live book without a retained overlay
Pause and Resume update button state and quote activity

limits: UI observations validate controls and inspected states; they do not measure display frame times or rule out every transient hitch.
Installed Telegram was not rebuilt; shared fixtures are source resources for its next build.
CPU is percent of one core and includes renderer-host plus WebKit helpers, excluding WindowServer.
Both engines use QuickJS and the same sandbox policy; this is not raw WebKit/JavaScriptCore.
Free-running callbacks do not hold completed paint work constant and are not displayed FPS.
Default timing windows are nearly transparent; manual interaction checks used opaque standalone apps.
The resizing ticker triggers rendering-budget coalescing in two of three native runs; lower CPU alone would not establish smoother output.
